integration_profile.instructions_digest: SELECT: sha256 of the integrator instruction bytes sealed into the bundle (owner)
integration_profile.profile_kind: SELECT: the integration profile kind (owner). This two-stage Job submits no integration stage, but bootstrap REQUIRES the profile document

policy_generation: SELECT: the policy generation this install pins (owner); read back after step 3 and compared before any dependent grant
pool_generation: SELECT: the pool generation (owner); a positive whole number
retention_policy_digest: SELECT: sha256 of the selected retention policy (owner); a fixture digest is not a production selection
